behavior.note: the 200px minimum width of Input, Textarea, NumberInput, Select, Combobox and DatePicker (--enchase-input-min-width) no longer goes past the container: in a container narrower than the minimum the field shrinks with it, where it used to stick out. With room, a field measures what it did. The computed min-inline-size of the control is now min(<the hook>, 100%), and the root of each field has a ::before with no height that holds the minimum

the SegmentedControl no longer breaks a label, and scrolls sideways when the options do not fit: it used to break the labels anywhere, also inside a word, and grow taller. With fullWidth, an option whose label does not fit in an equal share takes the width of its label, and the others share the rest. The root, which now scrolls, has tabindex="-1" (and getGroupProps of useSegmentedControl returns tabIndex: -1), so it is not a tab stop of its own in Firefox
the bubble of the Tooltip says its side in data-placement, as the Popover does, and no longer in data-position: rename the attribute in a selector of yours that styles the bubble by its side

in the experimental Board, the move-to menu names a column by its label, or by its title when the title is text, where it showed the whole title node; with sortable={false} it leaves out the column the card is in, and a card with nowhere to go has no menu button. The native drag of a link or an image inside a card is cancelled, so a click that shakes still reaches the link
